attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ce.caller_symbol_id AS passing_symbol_id, ce.callee_symbol_id AS passed_symbol_id FROM code.call_edges ce WHERE ce.passes_as_callback AND NOT ce.calls_directly AND ce.caller_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce.callee_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce.caller_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND ce.callee_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND NOT ce.caller_in_test_file AND NOT ce.callee_in_test_file AND NOT ce.is_self_call

request:
Inside the bodies of functions and methods in the click library (src/click/), where is a module-level function or a method defined in the repository passed by reference as an argument to another call (so the receiving call is expected to invoke it) rather than being called at that point? Module-level code outside any function, and nested helper functions, do not count. Give the symbol ID of the function or method containing the call and the symbol ID of the function passed, one row per distinct pair.

Requested output columns: passing_symbol_id (string), passed_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Uses the call_edges view to find edges where a symbol is passed as a callback reference (passes_as_callback true) but not directly called at that site (calls_directly false). Restricts callers to functions/methods in src/click/ and callees to repository functions/methods, excluding test files and self-calls. Returns distinct caller/callee symbol ID pairs.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ce.caller_symbol_id AS passing_symbol_id, ce.callee_symbol_id AS passed_symbol_id FROM code.call_edges ce WHERE ce.passes_as_callback AND NOT ce.calls_directly AND ce.caller_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce.callee_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce.caller_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND ce.callee_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND NOT ce.caller_in_test_file AND NOT ce.callee_in_test_file AND NOT ce.is_self_call
